description_en: Modifies event information in Event Center
description_zh: 修改事件中心的事件信息
name: ModifyEventInfo

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The event ID. You can call the DescribeEvents operation to query event IDs. To query multiple events, separate the event IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 20 event IDs are supported
parameters.help_zh: 事件ID，可调用DescribeEvents获取。如需查询多个事件，使用英文逗号分隔，最多支持20个
parameters.name: event_id

parameters.help_en:
The event action. Valid values:
archive: Archives the event.
undo: Does not process the event.
This parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
事件处理动作，取值说明：
archive：归档
undo：不处理
该参数为必填参数
parameters.name: event_action

parameters.help_en:
The action-related parameters, which can be an extension based on business requirements. When taskAction is set to modifySwitchTime, set ActionParams to `{"recoverMode": "xxx", "recoverTime": "xxx"}`.

recoverMode specifies the task recovery pattern. Valid values:
timePoint: Executes at a specified point in time.
immediate: Executes immediately.

recoverTime specifies the recovery time in UTC+0. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ. This parameter is required when recoverMode is set to timePoint
parameters.help_zh:
动作相关的参数，根据业务需要扩展，当taskAction取modifySwitchTime时，ActionParams取值` {"recoverMode": "xxx", "recoverTime": "xxx"}`。

recoverMode表示任务恢复模式，取值说明：
timePoint：按照时间点执行
immediate：立即执行

recoverTime表示恢复时间，UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。当recoverMode取timePoint时，recoverTime必填
parameters.name: action_params
